title: Affine scalar contraction
statement: Let $q>0$ and $0\le c\le 1$, and suppose that $|1-cz|^q\le |1+z|^q-q(1+c)z$ for every real $z$. Then, for all real $a$ and $x$, $|a-cx|^q\le |a+x|^q-[q(1+c)|a|^q/a]x$, where the quotient is interpreted as zero when $a=0$.
hypotheses_covered: The scalar inequality holds for every real $z$
replaced: Let $q>0$ and $0\le c\le1$ satisfy $|1-cz|^q\le|1+z|^q-q(1+c)z$ for every real $z$. Then for all real $a,x$, $|a-cx|^q\le|a+x|^q-[q(1+c)|a|^q/a]x$, with the quotient interpreted as zero when $a=0$.
